summary: Known only from a Georgia tower list (2016): coordinates, Marion County, elevation and a gfc-308 tag. No source found on its build, design or current state.

notes_for_editor: Only one source names this tower: a tnlandforms.us list last revised March 2016 that gives county, coordinates, an unlabelled elevation (702, taken as feet; the record's 214 m assumes that) and a gfc-308 tag. No register entry, agency page, build date, design, status or access source was found in the NHLR or FFLOS caches, the FFLA Georgia page (no data) or the web. The story's only context sentence is about a different tower in Waycross. Needs a field check or a Marion County source before it is treated as more than a location.
